start.welcome:
👋 Welcome to the Genshin Impact bot!

Link your account with /genshinlogin <UID> to get started, then try /mycharacters.

Use /help to see everything I can do.
help.text: 📖 Commands Account /genshinlogin — link your Genshin UID /genshinlogout — unlink your account /myuid — show your linked UID /myinfo — show your account info Characters /mycharacters (/myc) — browse your showcased characters /inspect — inspect another player's showcase Spiral Abyss /abyss — current Abyss /preabyss — previous Abyss /abysscard — current Abyss card /preabysscard — previous Abyss card Imaginarium Theater /theater — current Theater /theatercard — Theater card More /banner — banner information /build_guide — build recommendations /settings — your settings /language — change language
